name_reason: Current name is a misnomer. The function does not touch any party/character roster. It copies the active shop tier's item-id list out of the cached chapter-intro metadata entry (data_fd2_chapter_intro_active_metadata_entry_ptr @ 0x54137) into the caller buffer. The metadata-accessor plate (fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry @ 0x4e4b9) documents the source struct fields read here as bWeapons[12] (+3), bItems[8] (+0xF), bMystery[8] (+0x17) -- all shop item-id arrays with 0xFF empty-slot sentinel. The sole caller fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main passes the result straight to fd2_run_buy_item_menu, whose own plate names the parameter shop_item_id_array and uses each byte as an item id (fd2_get_item_effect_entry, fd2_add_item_to_inventory). Proposed name fd2_load_chapter_shop_item_ids follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> and matches the sibling load_chapter_* idiom in rsrc.c; no address residue.
purpose: Copy the active shop tier's item-id list (weapons/items/mystery) for the chapter-intro shop menu from the cached chapter-intro metadata entry into the caller's buffer, returning the count.
logic_summary: max_count defaults to 8. Selects the source sub-array by data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state @ 0x5412B: state==1 -> cap 0xC, offset 0x03 (weapons); state==3 -> cap 8, offset 0x0F (items); else -> cap 8, offset 0x17 (mystery). Then loops iter=0..cap-1 reading *(data_fd2_chapter_intro_active_metadata_entry_ptr + offset + iter); breaks on the 0xFF empty-slot sentinel, otherwise stores the byte to out_buf[out_count] and increments out_count. Returns out_count. Comparison is signed (CMP EDX,EBP; JGE). out_count (ESI) and iter (EDX) advance in lockstep because 0xFF only breaks, never skips.

params.name: out_buf
params.semantics: Destination buffer that receives the copied shop item-id bytes (caller passes a 12-byte stack buffer; written via out_buf[out_count]).
params.reason: src already declares the accurate name out_buf (not param_1) and matches its role as the output buffer; no address residue. (Ghidra decompiles it as param_1 only because __CHK obscures the prototype; the src is correct.)

returns.semantics: Number of item ids written to out_buf before hitting the 0xFF sentinel or the tier cap; consumed by the caller as menu_visible_item_count and passed to fd2_run_buy_item_menu.

comment_original_issue: The original src comment was already substantially correct (described shop sub-menus, item IDs, 0xFF sentinel, the three offsets) but used the vague phrase 'available rows' and echoed the misleading party-roster framing only via the function-name heading. Refined to state explicitly that this loads the active shop tier's item-id list, named the three metadata sub-arrays (bWeapons/bItems/bMystery via fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry), clarified the caller forwards the buffer to fd2_run_buy_item_menu as the shop item-id array, and flagged that the function name is a pending-rename misnomer.
